title: First perks unlock
summary: Eight of the starting perks can now be unlocked, and each shows its key numbers in the perks menu.
highlights: Health, Speed, Damage, Stackable Book and Quill, Friendliness, See Trade Values, Bigger Backpacks and Craft Level Stats now work.
Each one shows what it gives now and what your next point adds.
Friendliness also helps when you tame animals with gifts.
